title: Spinning Swing
description: Spin your weapon around yourself, dealing weapon damage to all adjacent targets. Afterwards, you must perform an acrobatics check of (PL*3) or fall prone.

title: Impact
description: A powerful blow with the user’s full weight behind it. When hit, the opponent must make a strength contest against the user. If they lose, they get knocked back (PL*5) ft.

title: Heavy Blow
description: On hit, the opponent has to make a fortitude check with a DC of your (PL*3), or lose one reaction for the rest of the round.

title: Bone Breaker
description: A strike that sends shockwaves through your opponent’s body. On hit, they must make a fortitude check with a DC of your (PL*3). If they fail, their movement is halved for 2 turns.

title: Shatter
description: A powerful hit with large wind up and centrifugal force. If blocked, the opponent must make a fortitude check with a DC of your (PL*3+3). If failed, their block only lessens 25% of the damage for 2 turns.

title: Artery Knick
description: Perform a slashing attack attempting to target an opponent’s vitals. If you hit, the target must roll a Fortitude check against a DC equal to your Technique Level * 3. If they fail, they suffer from the Bleed condition.

title: Descending Slash
description: A downward slashing attack performed from high up, dealing an additional 1d4 for every 10 ft. fallen. At a base, jump up 10 ft. to perform this technique. After 20 ft. fallen, take 1d4 (unmitigatable and unreactable) recoil damage for every 10 ft. fallen.

title: Sword Dance
description: Perform a slashing attack. You may then move up to 10ft. freely without consuming movement speed.
